sections.title: TK health insurance: for her visa appointment

info.a: TK's Allgemeine Versicherungsbescheinigung (or Mitgliedsbescheinigung) confirms active statutory health insurance in Germany. It comes in two forms. Yours proves you are an active TK member who can add your wife. Hers is issued only after she arrives, registers her address and is enrolled in TK family insurance (Familienversicherung).

German law requires proof of health insurance before any visa or residence permit. At the embassy or consulate, your TK certificate plus her incoming insurance shows she moves into public health insurance on arrival. At the Ausländerbehörde, her own TK certificate is needed to turn her D visa into a residence permit (Aufenthaltstitel). Until her TK card arrives, the certificate is her proof of cover at doctors, hospitals and pharmacies.

info.q: Can TK issue it in her name before the wedding?
info.a: No. Family insurance is only for a legal spouse, so a passport is not enough; TK needs the marriage certificate. Even after the wedding, her cover normally starts only once she lives in Germany and has registered her address (Anmeldung). For the visa appointment you use your own certificate and her incoming insurance instead.

The same statutory benefits as yours, at no extra cost: doctors and specialists, hospital stays and surgery, check-ups, cancer screening, vaccinations, pregnancy care and childbirth, prescriptions (standard co-payments), physiotherapy, dental check-ups and basic treatment, and long-term care insurance (Pflegeversicherung).

A legal spouse who lives in Germany, whose regular total income is no more than €565 a month in 2026 (€603 from a mini-job), and who is not mainly self-employed or privately insured. Check the current limits with TK before applying.

Before the wedding: nothing to do at TK. After the wedding, for the visa appointment: your TK certificate plus her incoming insurance. On arrival: Anmeldung, then apply for family insurance; enrolment usually takes 1 to 3 weeks. At the Ausländerbehörde: her own TK certificate. Checklists vary by embassy and immigration office, so confirm with yours.

faq.q: Who can change their name legally in India?
faq.a: Anyone aged 18 or over. For a minor, the parents apply on the child's behalf.

faq.q: How do you make a name change after marriage affidavit?
faq.a: Draft it with her maiden name, new name, your name, the date of marriage and her address. Print it on stamp paper (e-stamp is fine). Sign it in front of a Notary Public, who attests it with seal and signature.

faq.q: What stamp paper value should she use?
faq.a: Stamp duty differs by state. With e-stamp paper there is no fixed value for this affidavit, and Rs 10 is the amount most commonly used.
Yes. Notarisation confirms she is the person signing and that she affirms the statements. Get it attested by a Notary Public.

faq.q: What does she do with the affidavit afterwards?
faq.a: In India, present it with the marriage certificate to update PAN, Aadhaar, bank accounts, the local municipality and other records.

faq.q: Does she need a newspaper advert or Gazette notification?
faq.a: Not for a surname only change after marriage. Example: Sunita Garg to Sunita Bansal needs neither. A full name change does: Sunita Garg to Neha Bansal needs adverts in two newspapers (one regional language, one English, keep 4 to 5 originals) and then a Gazette of India notification.

faq.q: How does the Gazette of India notification work, if ever needed?
faq.a: Send the notarised affidavit, the original newspaper adverts, the filled specimen format (paper and soft copy), a signed declaration and undertaking, a demand draft to the Controller of Publication, Delhi (Rs 1,100 in your notes), two photos with the new name typed below, and a self attested photo ID. Documents must be under one year old. Published notices can be downloaded from egazette.nic.in.

faq.q: What types of name affidavits exist?
faq.a: Name change affidavit (any name change, used for the Gazette). Name change after marriage (a woman changing her maiden name). One and the same person (proves different names on documents belong to one person). Annexure D (passport: woman's name change after marriage, in India). Annexure E (passport: other name changes). Annexure letters can change, so check the current list at the Passport Seva Kendra.

faq.q: Which affidavit does the Munich Consulate need?
faq.a: For a passport reissue at CGI Munich, the Consulate's own Joint Affidavit, signed by both of you in front of the Consular Officer, together with the government marriage certificate. A notarised Indian affidavit does not replace it.

faq.q: Will German offices accept the Indian affidavit?
faq.a: Not on its own. German offices, banks and insurers go by her passport, backed by the government marriage certificate or a CGI Munich Name Change Certificate. A stamp paper affidavit carries little weight there.
